data.one_liner: A VLC-powered alternative to Flutter's video_player supporting multiple players.
data.what_it_does: Provides a VLC-powered video player widget and controller for Flutter applications on Android and iOS. Supports multiple players on one screen, loading media from networks or local storage, and casting features.
use_when: You need a video player that supports multiple instances on a single screen.
You need compatibility with a wider range of media formats than Flutter's default video_player.
You need iOS simulator playback support, which standard video_player lacks.
avoid_when: You only need simple web video playback without complex mobile VLC bindings.
You want to avoid platform-specific configuration overhead on Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports multiple players on a single screen simultaneously.
Built-in support for streaming, subtitles, and recording features.
weaknesses: Recording feature can fail if the video reaches its end before stopping.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding permissions and configurations for Internet and storage access in AndroidManifest.xml and iOS Info.plist, alongside specific Gradle and Podfile configurations.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Flutter video player plugin backed by the Flutter team.
